approval_required_for: Changing the selected template library/template set, adding new operator templates, or replacing template-derived modules with free-form RTL.
Changing stage4 parameter binding, model tensor shapes, stream/data order, memory layout, or numeric policy.
Assigning a nonzero clock_target_mhz or board timing target without cited board-profile/tool evidence.

executable_actions.on_failure: Treat the failure as a current-stage blocker; do not promote generated code. Invoke bounded_template_repair only for mismatches repairable within the existing template library and stage4 parameter binding; otherwise request backtrack or approval before changing templates, parameters, shapes, or numeric policy.
executable_actions.rationale: The supplied package_static_check, codegen_contract_check, and compile/elaboration gate all pass; materialize the expected audit and trace artifacts so downstream agents consume checker-grounded provenance rather than free-form RTL assumptions.

executable_actions.on_failure: Hold downstream promotion until the handoff records cite the checker logs, preserve SACG constraint links, and explicitly state that no functional simulation, timing, bitstream, or board pass is being claimed.
executable_actions.rationale: Downstream cross-layer model/numeric, memory/runtime, and evidence-gate agents need a compact handoff that preserves the template-provenance pass, structural package pass, and compile-only evidence boundary.

observations: State summary reports zero active contamination barriers and zero open retry/backtrack requests; no current SACG-memory blocker is listed for this code_generation audit.
The previous stage outcome states that stage4.parameter_binding and parameter_static_checks are ready, with parameter static checks passed.

candidate_stage_artifact.status is ready; target_model_artifact_status.current_artifacts_match_target is true and missing_for_target is empty, so the supplied manifest represents the planned qwen2 target artifact set.

The generated package manifest includes generated.chisel_modules, generated.top_wrapper, generated.fpga_axi_ddr_top_wrapper, generated.memory_layout, generated.runtime_config, generated.scala_contract_check, generated.codegen_compile_gate, and generated.codegen_contract_check as generated or pass-status planned outputs.

Visible copied Scala template files under src/main/scala/spatialaccagent/templates are covered by the manifest template_sources list: Activation.scala, Attention.scala, Common.scala, DecoderBlock.scala, Elementwise.scala, FFN.scala, KVCache.scala, Linear.scala, Mask.scala, Norm.scala, QKVProjection.scala, Residual.scala, RoPE.scala, and Softmax.scala.

selected_operator_template_sources records the selected operator-level template sources as Attention.scala, DecoderBlock.scala, Elementwise.scala, FFN.scala, Mask.scala, Norm.scala, Residual.scala, and Softmax.scala; additional support templates are represented in the full template_sources list.

codegen_package_static_check reports pass with no errors or warnings and checked generated_package_required_files, target_artifact_match_explicit, planned_output_status, template_source_coverage, and compile_and_contract_gate_status; its summary states the generated package manifest is structurally complete.

codegen_contract_check reports pass with no errors or warnings and checked upstream_transition_status, model_shape_to_generated_params, numeric_policy_to_generated_bits, template_provenance_hashes, compile_and_elaboration_warning_free, memory_layout_alignment_nonoverlap, runtime_config_consistency, and parameter_binding_legality.

The compile gate reports returncode 0 and pass for all four declared SBT commands: Compile/compile, GeneratedContractCheck, ElaborateGeneratedAccelerator, and ElaborateGeneratedAxiDdrTop. This is sufficient current-stage compile/elaboration evidence for the generated accelerator and AXI/DDR top wrappers.

generated_top records model_type qwen2, top_class LlamaStyleBlock, param_class LlamaStyleBlockParams, fpga_wrapper_class GeneratedAxiDdrTop, and bound parameters including hidden_size 896, num_q_heads 14, num_kv_heads 2, head_dim 64, max_seq_len 16, elem_bits 16, input_bits 32, output_bits 32, lanes 8, and intermediate_size 4864. Acceptance is based on the passed parameter/provenance contract checks, not on unaudited free-form RTL inspection.

No separately-authored non-template source RTL is identified in the supplied summary. The listed .sv files appear as generated/elaborated outputs under generated/chisel, while source Scala templates and generated wrapper/parameter glue are represented in the package source tree and covered by static contract evidence.

The generation_policy value from_scratch_target_accelerator_package is not used as a correctness claim by itself; provenance acceptance is grounded in template_provenance_hashes, template_source_coverage, parameter_binding_legality, and compile/elaboration pass evidence.
proposed_actions: Finalize template_codegen_audit.json, generated_source_to_template_trace.json, and compile_gate_evidence_summary.json from the supplied package_static_check, contract_check, compile_gate, template library metadata, stage2 template selection, and stage4 parameter binding evidence.
Hand off the audit pack to code_generation.cross_layer_model_numeric_auditor to independently consume the model/shape/numeric parameter evidence without changing model semantics or numeric policy.

Hand off generated memory_layout.json, runtime_config.json, and wrapper evidence to code_generation.memory_runtime_package_engineer for later board/runtime validation; preserve that clock_target_mhz=0 is an unknown shell-clock placeholder until board evidence or approval exists.

Hand off compile/contract/package pass logs to code_generation.evidence_gate_auditor with an explicit compile-only evidence boundary so later verification/deployment gates require real functional, protocol, Vivado, bitstream, and board evidence.

No bounded_template_repair is currently proposed. If a rerun finds a template hash, template coverage, or parameter legality mismatch, repair must stay within the selected template library and stage4 parameter constraints or request approval/backtrack.
risks: No current-stage template provenance, parameter-binding, compile-gate, or package-structure blocker is indicated by the supplied pass evidence.

Later-stage evidence boundary: compile/elaboration/static contract pass does not establish functional numerical correctness, data-order correctness, AXI/DDR protocol correctness, Vivado timing/resource closure, bitstream validity, or board execution.

Later-stage board-timing risk: generated_top.clock_target_mhz is 0, so downstream backend stages must not infer or commit a nonzero timing target without board-profile/tool evidence or explicit approval.

Handoff hygiene risk: generated_files includes SBT target/classes/cache artifacts as well as source artifacts; downstream provenance and hashing should rely on the generated manifest/source-to-template trace, not compiled cache products.
output.summary: Supplied code_generation evidence supports a template-bound and structurally complete generated package: codegen_package_static_check, codegen_contract_check, and the compile/elaboration gate all report pass with no errors or warnings. This audit accepts current-stage template provenance and package structure only; it does not claim functional simulation, timing closure, bitstream generation, or board execution.
